metadata.cycle: 00:00 UTC cycle, D+1 forecast lead (+3h to +27h accumulation difference)
metadata.nwp_source: NOAA Global Forecast System (GFS) 0.25° Open Data
metadata.obs_source: India Meteorological Department (IMD) 0.25° Gridded Daily Rainfall
metadata.bust_truth_formula: ABS(F - O) > 25.0 mm AND (F > 10.0 mm OR O > 10.0 mm)

bust_cases_diagnostic.diagnostic_note: Diagnostic subgroup calculation only. Split conformal prediction guarantees apply marginally under exchangeability across the general sample space, not conditionally to post-hoc subsets selected by extreme forecast errors (>25 mm).

rule_a.label: Rule A: predicted_error > 25 mm & forecast > 10 mm
rule_a.nature: operational approximation; not identical to the ground-truth bust rule

rule_b.label: Rule B: derived bust risk score >= 0.70
rule_b.nature: derived bust risk score; model-based risk indicator, not a calibrated probability

rule_c.label: Rule C: conformal upper bound > 25 mm
rule_c.nature: 80% split conformal prediction interval upper bound exceeding 25 mm
